metadata.name: Files
metadata.description: Browse, edit and organize the local folders and cloud Projects you allow ReAI to access.

permission.files: Read and write folders and cloud Projects you choose yourself: browse, open, save, create, rename, delete, and copy files between them
permission.projects: Use your own cloud account to list the cloud Projects you can access, so you can pick one to connect

toolbar.persistHint: Folders and cloud Projects you choose stay allowed until you remove them here or turn the permission off in Installed → Permissions.

state.notOpenTitle: File access is not available yet
state.notOpenDetail: This version of ReAI does not offer file access to this plugin. Update ReAI and try again.
state.notAuthorizedTitle: Folder access is not allowed yet
state.notAuthorizedDetail: Turn on “Access folders you choose” in Installed → Files → Permissions, then come back and select Check again.
state.staleTitle: This page is no longer valid
state.staleDetail: The account or plugin instance changed, so the page was cleared. Open Files again to continue.
state.noRootsDetail: Then you can browse, edit and organize its files here. The plugin only sees folders you choose.
state.chooseRootDetail: Open one of the folders above, or add a new one.
state.emptyFolderDetail: Create a file, or import one from another folder.
state.noSelectionDetail: Select a file on the left to see details. Text files can be edited here.
state.folderSelected: Folder: select its name to open it

file.tooLargeToEdit: Files over 1 MB cannot be edited here, but you can still copy them to another folder.
file.cleanCloud: Matches the file in the cloud

conflict.title: This file was changed somewhere else
conflict.detail: Nothing was saved, so the other changes are not overwritten. Your edits are still in the editor: reload the version on disk (discarding your edits), or save your version as a new file.
conflict.detailCloud: Nothing was saved, so the other changes are not overwritten. Your edits are still in the editor: reload the cloud version (discarding your edits), or save your version as a new file.

recovered.title: You have unsaved text
recovered.detail: Access to the folder containing “{name}” ended before your changes were saved. The text is kept only on this page and is gone when the page closes. Choose a folder to save it as a new file, or select the text to copy it.
recovered.needFolder: Open a folder first to save this as a new file.

dialog.nameInvalid: The name cannot be empty, contain / or \, or be . or ..
dialog.deleteDetail: It is deleted from your computer right away, not moved to the Trash, and cannot be undone. Folders can be deleted only when empty.
dialog.removeDetail: Files in the folder are not deleted; the plugin just stops seeing it. You can add it again later.
dialog.discardDetail: Changes to “{name}” are not saved and will be lost if you continue.
dialog.importDetail: Choose a source folder and select a file; it is copied into “{name}”.
dialog.exportDetail: Choose a destination folder, open the place you want, then select Copy here. Name clashes get a number instead of overwriting.
dialog.chooserNoRoots: No other folders yet. Select “Choose another folder…” to add one.
dialog.deleteCloudDetail: It is deleted from the cloud Project for everyone who can access it and cannot be undone here. Folders can be deleted only when empty.
dialog.removeCloudDetail: Files in the cloud Project are not deleted; the plugin just stops seeing it. You can connect it again later.

operation.pick: Waiting for you to choose a folder in the system window
operation.attach: Waiting for you to confirm in ReAI

notice.tooLateToCancel: Too late to cancel: “{name}” was already written
notice.revoked: Access to the folder has ended
notice.cloudDeclined: The cloud Project was not connected

errors.title: That did not finish
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.RESOURCE_REVISION_CONFLICT: The file or folder changed somewhere else. The list was refreshed; please try again.
errors.RESOURCE_ALREADY_EXISTS: Something with that name already exists here. Try another name.
errors.RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND: It is no longer there; it may have been moved or deleted. Refresh to see the latest contents.
errors.RESOURCE_PATH_INVALID: That name or location cannot be used.
errors.RESOURCE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: Files over 50 MB cannot be copied.
errors.RESOURCE_IO_FAILED: Reading or writing the file failed. Folders must be empty to be deleted.
errors.RESOURCE_TRANSFER_EXPIRED: The transfer waited too long and expired. Please try again.
errors.RESOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: The file service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.RESOURCE_PICK_REJECTED: That folder cannot be shared with plugins (for example a system folder or ReAI's own data). Choose another one.
errors.RESOURCE_LISTING_CHANGED: The folder just changed, so the first page was read again.
errors.TEXT_TOO_LARGE: Files over 1 MB cannot be edited here.
errors.TEXT_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: This is not a UTF-8 text file, so it cannot be edited here.
errors.DRAFT_UNSAVED: Save or discard the changes you are editing before renaming.
errors.FOLDER_PICK_ALREADY_OPEN: A folder chooser window is already open.
errors.FOLDER_PICK_RATE_LIMITED: Too fast. Wait a moment, then choose again.
errors.FOLDER_PICK_VISIBLE_SURFACE_REQUIRED: Go back to the Files page, then choose a folder.
errors.FOLDER_PICK_FAILED: The system folder chooser could not open.
errors.CLOUD_NOT_OPEN: The cloud file service is not open yet.
errors.CLOUD_ROUTE_MISSING: The cloud file service is unavailable: the server does not offer this yet.
errors.CLOUD_LOGIN_TEMPORARY: The plugin's cloud sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
errors.CLOUD_UNAVAILABLE: The cloud file service is temporarily unavailable. Refresh or try again later.
errors.CLOUD_NOT_CONNECTED: This plugin is not connected to your cloud account. Sign in to ReAI, then reinstall or re-authorize the Files plugin.
errors.CLOUD_NOT_AUTHORIZED: You don't have access to this cloud Project, or access was withdrawn. Unsaved text is kept on this page.
errors.CLOUD_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN: The request was stopped and it is unknown whether the cloud applied it. Refresh to see the current state before continuing.
errors.CLOUD_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the cloud file service. Check the network, then refresh.
errors.CLOUD_IO_FAILED: The cloud file service reported an error. Refresh and try again.
errors.CLOUD_NOT_SUPPORTED: This version of ReAI cannot connect cloud Projects. Update ReAI and try again.
errors.CLOUD_PROJECT_ID_INVALID: No Project ID found. Paste the full Project link or the ID itself.

cloud.title: Connect a cloud Project
cloud.detail: Pick one of your cloud Projects. ReAI then asks you to confirm; the plugin can only reach Projects you confirm.
cloud.listUnavailable: Your Projects cannot be listed automatically yet. Enter a Project ID or paste a Project link below.
cloud.noProjects: No cloud Projects found for this account. You can still enter a Project ID below.
cloud.inputInvalid: No Project ID found. Paste the full Project link or the ID itself.
cloud.inputHelp: You can copy the link from the Project page in your browser.

listErrors.PROJECTS_NOT_CONNECTED: This plugin is not connected to your cloud account yet, so your Projects cannot be listed.
listErrors.PROJECTS_SCOPE_MISSING: This plugin has not been allowed to see your Project list.
listErrors.PROJECTS_NOT_OFFERED: The cloud service does not offer the Project list yet.
listErrors.PROJECTS_UNREACHABLE: Could not read your Projects. Check the network and try again.
listErrors.PROJECTS_INVALID: The cloud service returned an unexpected Project list.
listErrors.PROJECTS_PERMISSION_REQUIRED: Turn on “List your cloud Projects” in Installed → Files → Permissions to see your Projects here.
